test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: Select the option that provides an accurate summary of the main points discussed in the passage.

options.text: Engaging in regular physical activity positively impacts mental health by releasing endorphins and reducing symptoms of anxiety and depression.
The passage discusses the negative effects of technology on health.
Exercise requires intense workouts for mental health benefits.
Exercise only impacts physical well-being, not mental health.

solution:
The correct answer is: Option 1. 
Option 1 accurately summarizes the passage, which highlights the positive effects of regular physical activity on mental health, such as reducing anxiety and depression through endorphin release.
